race.title: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (Gbb Race)
race.analyst_verdict: PACIFIC MISSION was very green on her recent debut at Ascot and, hailing from the Andrew Balding stable, it's reasonable to expect a much-improved showing second time up, so she's taken to prove a different proposition now upped to 7f and fitted with a tongue tie. John & Thady Gosden saddle a pair of noteworthy debutantes in Maneuver and Izz'nt She Hot, and strong market support for either would need taking very seriously.

runner.analyst_comment: Lope De Vega filly. Half-sister to several winners, including smart 8.4f-1¼m winner Georgeville and useful 1m winner Baseman. Held back by inexperience when sixth of 7 in 6f novice at Ascot on debut 19 days ago and surely capable of a fair bit better. Tongue strap on for 1st time.
